paperTitleZh: 歷年模仿卷（2016）— 試卷二
instructionsZh: 本試卷共 45 題，全部為多項選擇題。第 1–30 題為甲部，第 31–45 題為乙部。每題一分，答錯不扣分。
instructionsEn: There are 45 questions in this paper, all of which are multiple-choice questions. Questions 1–30 are in Section A and Questions 31–45 are in Section B. Each question carries 1 mark. No marks are deducted for wrong answers.

II. 該數列的某些項為無理數。
III. 該數列首 $99$ 項之和大於 $3\times 10^{28}$ 。
Let $a_{n}$ be the $n$th term of a geometric sequence. If $a_{3}=12$ and $a_{6}=96$ , which of the following must be true?
I. The common ratio of the sequence is less than $1$ .
II. Some of the terms of the sequence are irrational numbers.
III. The sum of the first $99$ terms of the sequence is greater than $3\times 10^{28}$ .

options.B:
只有 I 及 III
I and III only
options.D:

questions.questionText:
下面的莖葉圖顯示一組學生在測驗中分數（以分計）的分佈。Ada 在測驗中取得最高分。
莖（十位） | 葉（個位）
$4$ | $5\ 6\ 7\ 8$
$5$ | $5\ 5\ 6\ 8$
$6$ | $3\ 5\ 5\ 6\ 9\ 9$
$7$ | $0\ 0\ 1$
$8$ | $0\ 2\ 5$
下列何者為正確？
I. 分佈的上四分位數為 $69$ 分。
II. Ada 在測驗中的標準分低於 $2$ 。
III. 分佈的標準差大於 $12$ 分。
The stem-and-leaf diagram below shows the distribution of the scores (in marks) of a group of students in a test. Ada gets the highest score in the test.
Stem (tens) | Leaf (units)
$4$ | $5\ 6\ 7\ 8$
$5$ | $5\ 5\ 6\ 8$
$6$ | $3\ 5\ 5\ 6\ 9\ 9$
$7$ | $0\ 0\ 1$
$8$ | $0\ 2\ 5$
Which of the following is/are true?
I. The upper quartile of the distribution is $69$ marks.
II. The standard score of Ada in the test is lower than $2$ .
III. The standard deviation of the distribution is greater than $12$ marks.

questions.questionText:
一組數的方差為 $36$ 。將該組中每個數乘以 $5$ ，然後每個結果加上 $7$ ，組成一組新的數。求新一組數的方差。
The variance of a set of numbers is $36$ . Each number of the set is multiplied by $5$ and then $7$ is added to each resulting number to form a new set of numbers. Find the variance of the new set of numbers.
